entities.summary: Philippe Lazzarini (b. 1964, Canton of Neuchâtel) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Canton of Neuchâtel and Switzerland. Known in the fields of switzerland, merchants & economists, europe.
